owner: analysis/policy within the existing GTC analysis root; generation U64 remains once per accepted source

block_transitions.gain_peak: For each successful 256-sample channel block, current_peak=R32(2*max_i(abs(R32(x[i])))); summary=max(current_peak,old_previous_peak); gain output uses only lanes0..4; LFE peak state advances but has no FBW gain output; next previous_peak=current_peak for all six lanes.
block_transitions.db_selector: Per channel mean uses four fresh +0 F32 accumulators and exact F09G sample order. Maximum scans internal lanes0..4; equal values choose the later lane. Existing selector U16 is input to hysteresis. Successful block code becomes next selector.
block_transitions.counters: Each root-local completed_blocks counter increments once per successful block in the staged source. After a complete six-block source each advances by6. Counters do not affect numerical selection; they retain the leaf completion state defined by F09G.
block_transitions.source_commit: Root policy generation advances once only when the whole source is accepted by the existing parent transaction. A failure after any staged block drops all staged state; no partial block counters/peaks/selector commit.

cold_reset: Both six peaks +0; gain completed_blocks0; db selector0 and completed_blocks0. Full programme reset reconstructs cold policy owner with all other GTC roots.

removed_from_persistent_root.gain_db_history_u32_words_64: Same-source delayed-LFE-tail square projection only; optional same-source diagnostic/fixture value, no next-source algorithm reader. Do not use as a substitute for six current peaks.
removed_from_persistent_root.exponent_refresh_history_u16_words_30: Synthetic fixture projection only; no general producer or next-source consumer. Remove from production persistent root.
removed_from_persistent_root.normalized_anchor_u16_words_30: F10 per-source NumericPlan output, not next-source state. Remove from production persistent root; keep current-source anchors in NumericPlan.

per_source_scratch.rule: These remain normal algorithm/planning outputs where specified; exclusion applies only to persistent root fields.

canonical: Reuse existing GTC sorted-key UTF-8 JSON owner serialization and receipts. Amendment replaces the policy projection in the full analysis owner; no new digest, owner or receipt ABI.
scope: Does not alter F09/F10 numerical algorithms, selected bin limits, provider values or candidate search.
